Attached: 1 image

Xolotl runs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash - all 552 billion parameters - on one gaming PC at 33 tok/s on real agent tasks (41 in fast mode), beside GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8, LFM3-Omni and Muse Glimmer, all on one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible server. Built on Strata and grown 70,000 lines past it. My summary: https://blog.localai.hex7.com/xolotl-deepseek-v4-1-flash-at-552-billion-parameters-on-one-gaming-pc/ #LocalAI #OpenSource

Also on Bluesky: @privatelocalai.bsky.social
